name: Ink-Eyes
description: A legendary nezumi ninja, the most feared ninja on Kamigawa, who killed her ogre mentor and gained necromantic powers from the oni Kuro.

description_citations.text: "Ink-Eyes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ostracized by the Okiba gang, Ink-Eyes is taken deep into the Takenuma swamp and left to fend for herself as punishment.
timeline.quote: As punishment, she was taken deep into the Takenuma swamp and left to fend for herself.

citation.text: "Ink-Eyes", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Muzan catches Ink-Eyes stealing from him and takes her in as his student.
timeline.quote: The ogre saw the ruthless nezumi girl's potential and decided to take her in as his student

citation.text: "Ink-Eyes", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ink-Eyes kills Muzan in his sleep and offers his blood to the oni Kuro.
timeline.quote: she killed her ogre mentor in his sleep and offered his blood to their oni overlord, Kuro

citation.text: "Ink-Eyes", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pleased by her treachery, Kuro grants Ink-Eyes necromantic powers, and her eyes turn red.
timeline.quote: The oni was pleased by her treachery and ambition
